title: Parents with Baby under Tinsel Christmas Tree, 1940s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A touching late-1940s domestic snapshot showing an affectionate mother and father leaning down on the floor to look at their infant baby. In the background stands a Christmas tree heavily draped in silver foil icicle tinsel and glass ornaments. The baby lies bundled on a soft blanket alongside a stuffed plush toy, while the father wears a white collared shirt with a patterned necktie and the mother wears a period tailored dress.
